item.title: Pet Talk: Common symptoms may mask GI cancer in cats
item.description: Texas A&M photo Common but persistent cat symptoms such as stomach upset and weight loss may indicate a form of gastrointestinal cancer. It’s not unusual for cats to have the occasional upset stomach, but when issues persist, something more serious could be going on.
